description: This PHP source file defines the TimeReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin's API namespace. It extends the ReportAPI class and provides an endpoint for retrieving different types of time reports, such as project, activity detailed, employee, and attendance reports. The class includes a method to fetch the report class based on the report name parameter, with validation to ensure the report name is valid.

classes.name: TimeReportAPI
classes.description: Handles API requests for time reports, providing a method to retrieve specific report instances based on query parameters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate report class instance based on the report name provided in the request, validating the name against a predefined map.
